name: PEDON: Planting Guide
subtitle: Landscape designs on your site
promotional_text: Bring your PEDON landscape design onto the real site. See planting centers, compare mature plant sizes, and try the built-in sample garden without a Mac.
description:
Turn your PEDON landscape design into a guide you can use on site.

PEDON for iPhone is a companion to the free, open-source PEDON desktop editor. Your own garden needs a Mac running PEDON, a calibrated mesh scan of your site, and a design prepared in the desktop editor; the iPhone app does not create site scans or designs. To try it first, open the built-in sample garden from Settings: pick two points on its scan, mark any two spots on the ground around you, and walk through a small planted garden.

ALIGN WITH THE REAL SITE
Choose two recognizable features on your original scan, then match them on the real ground. Use the translucent Original scan overlay to compare fixed features with the camera and fine-tune the alignment.

SEE WHERE EACH PLANT GOES
Switch to Planting guide for small targets at the design's planting centers. Select a target to preview that plant at half opacity and its planned mature size. Show or hide individual plants and read the plant details included in your design.

KEEP THE VIEW CLEAR
Collapse the controls while you work. Switch between the planting guide and the full 3D design, and adjust which layers are visible.

RETURN TO YOUR WORK
Save the design and alignment on your iPhone. Reopening loads your offline copy and tries to recognize the saved location. Refresh over the same local network to get an updated design from your Mac.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No PEDON account, ads, or tracking. Camera references and saved spatial maps stay on your iPhone.

Requires an ARKit-capable iPhone with iOS 18 or later. LiDAR is optional. AR accuracy depends on your scan, reference points, lighting and device tracking; check fixed references and measured distances before planting or digging. Plant dimensions are design values, not guarantees of growth.
